page.layout: One page of text in a single column; margin note at the far left ("Cap. 27.") beside the top lines; running head at the top.

main_text.p: catur,1 Tim. 4. Et licet faturemur, recurrit tamen fames, & semper orandum, Matth. 6. Vide Christi exemplum, Iohan. 6. Matt. 14.16. Arguuntur quos pudet mensae benedicere, &c. Cap. 27.
¶ 3. Omnes recreantur animis. Vide quantum boni ex pijs Dei cultoribus oriatur. Vnus Paulus nunc omnia regit, & solus consilio & consolatione iuuat. Sic Abraham, Gen. 14. Ioseph.
Discamus tales in precio habere, quando hos contempsisse multis nocuit. Vide Gen. 19. Oremus.
main_text.head: HOMILIA CCII.
main_text.p: 37 Erant autem universa capita in navigio ducenta et septuaginta sex.
38 Caeterum saciati cibo, alleuabant navim, proijcientes frumentum in mare.
39 Quum autem dies ortus esset, terram non agnoscebant, sinum vero quendam animadverterunt habentem litus, in quem consilium coeperant, si possent expellere navim,
40 Igitur anchoris sublatis, permiserunt eam mari, simul laxatis vinculis gubernaculorum, et sublato arte-mone

page.notes: Top-left margin note "Cap. 27." is printed beside the first lines. Several words are blurred or uncertain, including the Latin in lines 37 to 40, which should be checked against the scan. The printed text ends mid-word "arte-mone", apparently "artemone" with the rest on the next page.
